name_english: The Field and the Knower of the Field
summary_short: Krishna explains the difference between the body and the conscious self.
summary_medium: This chapter distinguishes between the physical body (field) and the knower of the field (consciousness), describing true knowledge, humility, and awareness as the path to liberation.
summary_detailed: Definition of the body as the field.
The soul as the knower of the field.
what_you_learn: Why you are not your body or thoughts.
usage_note_for_app: Chapter 13 is ideal for grounding, identity clarity exercises, and reflective modes.
